Subject: Post-call recap: Vectra Bio reservation readiness & sizing checklist

Alicia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Highlights / pain we heard
- Production model latency spikes during peak inference windows (p99 observed ~480ms for current hosted endpoints).
- Cost sensitivity: strong need to reduce per-token unit economics for high volume batch/nearline jobs.
- Data isolation / PHI concerns: workloads must run in an isolated pool with strict network egress controls and US-only residency.
- Predictable throughput requirement for clinical workflows: sustained 40–60 inference/s with headroom to burst.

Goals we discussed
- Dedicated reserved pool (private/dedicated) to meet isolation and latency targets.
- Target SLOs: p50 ~ <45ms, p95 <120ms, p99 <250ms for interactive calls; 99.95% monthly uptime target for inference endpoints.
- Pilot window: 4-week tech evaluation followed by production ramp if metrics meet thresholds.
- Procurement timeline: you indicated internal approval by mid-June if numbers look reasonable.

Preliminary sizing suggestion (engineer-level starting point) — see attached spreadsheet for details:
- Baseline reserved capacity: 4 x A100-80GB equiv. (dedicated pool) for initial production; autoscale/burst to 8 nodes for peak windows.
- Expected sustained concurrency: 50 concurrent streams (model mix below).
- KV-cache and prefix caching to be enabled for clinical prompt reuse — reduces token compute ~25–40% depending on overlap.

Model / quantization recommendations we discussed
- Primary: quantized 13B family for most interactive flows (good cost/latency tradeoff).
- Heavy-batch reranking / embeddings: multi-GPU batched jobs on the same pool (nightly jobs).

Immediate open questions for sizing / commercial
1) Can you share typical prompt+response token distributions (median & 95th) for the three critical endpoints?
2) Confirm retention and audit log window required (you mentioned 90 days initially).
3) Procurement contact and PO process (who should I loop in on our side).

Attachments included: vectra_prelim_sizing_20270530.xlsx (workload assumptions + cost model), vectra_sla_draft_20270530.pdf (initial SLA language).

Next steps (owner / target date)
- Alicia: confirm token distributions & procurement contact — by 2027-06-03
- Jonas: produce a revised SOW and committed-cost estimate based on provided token mix — by 2027-06-04
- Karthik: schedule an ops-deep-dive with engineering (if needed) during week of 6/7 — owner: karthik_iyer

Thanks — talk soon.

—
